categories.main_business_segments: JinXianDai Information Industry Co., Ltd. operates primarily in two segments: customized industry digital solutions for large group enterprises such as power and aerospace sectors, and standardized, general software products centered around a low-code development platform. The company has a strong foothold in power industry digitalization and is expanding into aerospace, petrochemical, and industrial manufacturing sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including AI (large language models, natural language processing, computer vision, OCR, knowledge graphs), low-code/no-code development platforms, cloud-native architectures, and integration platforms (iPaaS). Its flagship low-code platform 'Qingqibing' supports visual drag-and-drop development, model-driven design, and AI-assisted code generation, enabling rapid software development with minimal coding. The company also develops intelligent document processing, smart Q&A systems, knowledge management, and laboratory information management systems (LIMS) using AI and big data.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are large state-owned enterprises and central enterprises in the power sector, including State Grid Corporation of China, China Southern Power Grid, and the five major power generation groups. The company also serves aerospace, petrochemical, industrial manufacturing, and other sectors. Its customer base includes Fortune Global 500 and China 500 companies, provincial state-owned enterprises, and leading private enterprises.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with significant revenue generated from the East China, North China, and South China regions. It has established a nationwide sales network with 21 provincial sales teams covering major Chinese provinces and cities.
categories.supply_chain_position: JinXianDai operates primarily as a midstream software and digital solutions provider, delivering customized software development, integration services, and standardized software products to end customers in power, aerospace, and other industries. It acts as a core supplier within the digital transformation ecosystem of large enterprises, particularly in power grid digitalization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on a 'dual-drive' development strategy emphasizing both customized industry digital solutions and standardized AI-powered low-code software products. It prioritizes R&D investment in AI technologies (LLM, NLP, CV, OCR, KG), low-code platforms, and industry-specific intelligent applications. The company maintains a strong commitment to technology innovation, talent acquisition, and integration of AI with traditional software to enhance product competitiveness and market expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through software product sales, customized software development and implementation services, and ongoing software maintenance contracts. The company also earns income from licensing its low-code platform and related AI-enabled software products. Sales are primarily conducted via direct sales and channel partners.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic provider of digital solutions and low-code platforms in the power and aerospace sectors, with a strong competitive advantage due to long-term relationships with major state-owned enterprises and advanced AI technology integration. Comparable companies in the industry include Guangguang Software, Henghua Technology, Hengshi Technology, Langxin Technology, and GuoNet Information Technology.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, JinXianDai reported revenues of approximately RMB 439.6 million, a 13.44% decrease from the previous year, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 11.5 million, down 8.93%. The company’s R&D investment remains high, accounting for 23.7% of revenue. Despite revenue decline due to business optimization and capacity reduction, standardized software product sales grew by 30.19%. The company maintains a solid asset base of about RMB 1.5 billion and continues to improve cash flow.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: JinXianDai emphasizes its deep industry expertise, especially in power sector digitalization, combined with cutting-edge AI and low-code technologies to deliver highly customizable and intelligent digital solutions. Its low-code platform reduces development costs and accelerates deployment, while AI integration enhances automation, data analysis, and operational efficiency. The company’s products are recognized for technical innovation, strong customer service, and adaptability to complex industry scenarios, providing clients with competitive advantages in digital transformation.
